PreToolUse.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const c=i.tool_input?.content||'';const lines=c.split('\n').length;if(lines>400){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: File exceeds 400 lines ('+lines+' lines). Split into smaller modules.');process.exit(2)}})"
PreToolUse.description: Block writes that exceed 400 lines (CLAUDE.md file size limit)

PostToolUse.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then cd /Users/nitinpandit/Custom/Doppler && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format TypeScript files with Prettier after edits

Stop.command: cd /Users/nitinpandit/Custom/Doppler && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -20 || true
Stop.description: Type-check the project when the session ends
